theme: Small talk đầu giờ & pantry chat

vocab.meaning_vi: dạo này thế nào?, mọi việc ổn chứ?
vocab.example: How's it going with the new testing tool your team started using last week?
vocab.example_vi: Mọi việc với công cụ kiểm thử mới mà nhóm bạn bắt đầu dùng tuần trước thế nào rồi?

vocab.example: Same here, I also spent the whole weekend fixing my old laptop at home.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi cũng vậy, tôi cũng dành cả cuối tuần để sửa cái laptop cũ ở nhà.

vocab.example: I often run into my old teammate near the coffee machine on Monday mornings.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi hay tình cờ gặp đồng đội cũ gần máy pha cà phê vào sáng thứ Hai.

vocab.example: Do you want to grab a bite downstairs before the sprint planning at one?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có muốn xuống dưới ăn nhanh gì đó trước buổi họp lên kế hoạch sprint lúc một giờ không?

vocab.meaning_vi: căng tin, nhà ăn của công ty
vocab.example: The canteen on the third floor is quiet before eleven, so we eat early.
vocab.example_vi: Căng tin ở tầng ba khá vắng trước mười một giờ, nên bọn tôi ăn sớm.

vocab.example: Sorry, I am in a rush because my code review starts in five minutes.
vocab.example_vi: Xin lỗi, tôi đang vội vì buổi review code của tôi bắt đầu sau năm phút nữa.

vocab.example: By the way, did you see the email about the office wifi upgrade tonight?
vocab.example_vi: Nhân tiện, bạn đã xem email về việc nâng cấp wifi văn phòng tối nay chưa?

vocab.meaning_vi: ra ngoài hít thở không khí
vocab.example: I usually get some fresh air after lunch to stay awake in the afternoon.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi thường ra ngoài hít thở không khí sau bữa trưa để buổi chiều đỡ buồn ngủ.

listening.title: Morning chat in the office pantry

lines.speaker: Hoa (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Morning, Minh. How's it going? You look a bit tired today.

lines.speaker: Minh (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Morning, Hoa. I am fine, just a little sleepy. The traffic was terrible.

lines.speaker: Hoa (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Same here. I left home at seven and still arrived ten minutes late.

lines.speaker: Minh (Backend Developer)
lines.text: By the way, did you try the new coffee machine in the pantry?

lines.speaker: Hoa (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Not yet. I usually make tea, but I can try it this morning.

lines.speaker: Minh (Backend Developer)
lines.text: You should. I run into half of the backend team here every morning.

lines.speaker: Hoa (QA Engineer)
lines.text: That is nice. Are you free at noon? We can grab a bite together.

lines.speaker: Minh (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Sure. The canteen is quiet before eleven thirty, so let us go early.

lines.speaker: Hoa (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Good idea. After lunch I like to get some fresh air for ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Minh (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Me too. Sorry, I am in a rush now, my standup starts in two minutes.

options: He is sleepy and the traffic was terrible
He worked all night on a production bug
He just came back from a business trip

questions.q: What does Minh suggest trying in the pantry?
options: The tea from the third floor
He has a call with a client
His standup starts in two minutes
He is going to the canteen now

shadowing: Morning, how's it going? You look tired, did you sleep badly again last night?
Same here, the traffic this morning was terrible and I arrived ten minutes late.
By the way, do you want to grab a bite in the canteen at noon?
Sorry, I am in a rush because my daily standup starts in two minutes.
I often run into my teammates here when I get some fresh air outside.
